elements.title: Sam Kee Building (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Sam Kee Building (pictured), recognized by Guinness World Records as the narrowest commercial building in the world, was built on a bet between two businessmen?

elements.title: a group of 25 women (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a group of 25 women disfigured by the atomic bombing of Hiroshima traveled to the United States in the 1950s to receive reconstructive surgery?

elements.title: Mary Sheffield (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Mary Sheffield is the youngest elected member and the youngest president in the Detroit City Council's history?

elements.title: Sympathy Is a Knife (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that fans speculated that Charli XCX wrote "Sympathy Is a Knife" about Taylor Swift and her relationship with Matty Healy?

elements.title: Bertrand of Toulouse (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the capture of the crusader Bertrand of Toulouse by Muslims was blamed by an anonymous monk on the "treachery" of Queen Melisende and Countess Hodierna?

elements.title: Chinook Indian Nation (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Chinook Indian Nation became a federally recognized tribe in 2001, but had its status revoked the following year?

elements.title: Liang Sishun (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Liang Sishun published an anthology of Chinese poetry in 1908, when she was about fifteen years old?

elements.title: Eoscorpius (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Eoscorpius, despite living hundreds of millions of years ago, has been noted for its similarity to modern scorpions?

elements.title: Frankish Tower (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a Greek academic compared the Frankish Tower in Athens with the droppings of birds of prey?
